summary: StatusCodeFormatter is a static class responsible for formatting, translating, and processing placement request (PR) status codes in the HSPnet UI. It handles complex business rules to display PR statuses differently depending on user roles, system modes, flags, and document state, including locale translation and conditional formatting.
purpose: To centralize and automate the display logic, translation, and processing of status codes for placement requests and related entities, ensuring business rules and user context are consistently applied in the HSPnet UI.
entities: User Roles (PlacementCoordinator, ReceivingCoordinator, DestinationCoordinator, Instructor, Supervisor)

workflows.name: FormatStatusCode
steps: Receives HSPnetSession and statusCode
Translates AccD to Redir for PlacementCoordinator
Translates Sent to Pend for NIS/IRP agencies or ReceivingCoordinator
Translates Redir to Pend for DestinationCoordinator
Returns formatted code

workflows.name: ProcessStatusCode / ProcessStatusCodeInboxOutbox
steps: Handle released NIS/IRP modes: Sent becomes Pend/Rel, others append /Rel
Display bolded Pend for Sent status to ReceivingCoordinator or in NIS/IRP mode (pending count incremented)
Grey out Pend for disabled requests
NewD is bolded for RA view (not NIS/IRP)
Outbox: add /NIS or /IRP for unreleased PRs
Sent/Printed: becomes Sent-P
Redir/Printed: becomes Redir-P
AccD/DecD in Outbox: show Redir/Redir-P
AutoRedirected Redir: A prefix
Outbox/HoldRequests: /Hold appended if hold date is after today
Reac in Inbox: bolded
CFO PR: append /CFO, AccA PR is greyed

workflows.name: RxStatus
steps: If locale is not default, replace status indicators for French translations (e.g. /Rel -> /Div, Pend -> Attn, Sent -> Env, Redir -> Réa etc.)
Order/superset rules to ensure correct translation
Uses ChangeStatus ref method for atomic replacements

workflows.name: AddPAWStatus
steps: If not Placeholder, append 'Sponsored' or 'Employee' indicators with formatting

workflows.name: FlagNonMember
steps: If agency is not a member, append * to agency name

business_rules: Released NIS/IRP: Sent becomes Pend/Rel, others append /Rel.
Unreleased NIS/IRP: Outbox PRs append /NIS or /IRP.
AccD/DecD + Outbox: Status becomes Redir or Redir-P.
HoldRequests in Outbox: If HoldUntilDate > Today, append /Hold.
Reac in Inbox: Bold status if enabled.
CFO PR + AccA: Grey status and append /CFO.
Locale translation: Replace status codes with French equivalents if locale is not default.
validations: StatusCode string checked for length and substrings for indicator manipulation.
Flags (NISFlag, IRPFlag, Printed, AutoRedirected, HoldRequests, CFO, Member) validated for logic branches.
HoldUntilDate checked for null and compared against current date.
Agency checked for membership before annotation.
calculations: PendFlag set true when PR is pending for current user and not disabled.
StatusCode string concatenations and substring checks for formatting and appending indicators.
conditions: Role determines which translation or formatting is applied.
Mode (NISMode, IRPMode) alters status formatting and translation.
Disabled state changes bolding and pending count eligibility.
Printed, AutoRedirected, HoldRequests, CFO, and Membership trigger status modifications.
system_behavior: Dynamically formats and translates PR status codes based on user context and business rules.
Ensures UI displays status with proper visual cues (bold, grey, appended indicators).
Handles locale-sensitive translation of status codes for French users.
Provides utility methods for annotation of sponsored, employee, and non-member indicators.
dependencies: System and .NET libraries for text handling.
exceptions: If date is null, Hold is not appended.
If string is empty or locale is default, translation does not occur.
If status is not matched, returns unmodified.
